description: This file contains database migration and schema management functions for the sqlstore package in the focalboard server, including migration execution, connection setup, and SQL statement generation for different database types.

methods.name: getMigrationConnection
methods.description: Establishes and returns a database connection configured for migrations, handling different database types and connection parameters.

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Performs database schema migrations, including setup, executing migration scripts, and cleanup.

methods.name: runMigrationSequence
methods.description: Executes all migration steps in order, including applying specific migrations and fixing database collations and charsets.

methods.name: ensureMigrationsAppliedUpToVersion
methods.description: Ensures that the database has applied all migrations up to a specified version.

methods.name: GetTemplateHelperFuncs
methods.description: Returns a map of helper functions for use in SQL migration templates.

methods.name: genAddColumnIfNeeded
methods.description: Generates SQL to add a column to a table if it does not already exist, tailored for different database types.

methods.name: genDropColumnIfNeeded
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop a column from a table if it exists, tailored for different database types.

methods.name: genCreateIndexIfNeeded
methods.description: Generates SQL to create an index if it does not already exist.

methods.name: genRenameTableIfNeeded
methods.description: Generates SQL to rename a table if it does not already have the new name.

methods.name: genRenameColumnIfNeeded
methods.description: Generates SQL to rename a column if it does not already have the new name.

methods.name: doesTableExist
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the database.

methods.name: doesColumnExist
methods.description: Checks if a column exists in a specified table.

methods.name: genAddConstraintIfNeeded
methods.description: Generates SQL to add a constraint to a table if it does not already exist.
